name: More window options
author: RussoDaFederal
description: This plugin allows you to spawn multiple text boxes with custom properties. To remove a window you spawned with this plugin, use the Remove Picture command. If you display a Picture with the same ID as a custom window, the window will be overwritten, and vice-versa. Use negative IDs for the windows. If you use positive IDs, they'll be drawn on top of other screen elements.

commands.name: Spawn window
commands.description: Spawn a window as if it was a picture. It can be deleted with "remove picture"

defaultParameters.name: id
defaultParameters.description: ID to assign to the window. Use negative values for default behavior

defaultParameters.name: x
defaultParameters.description: X screen position for the window

defaultParameters.name: y
defaultParameters.description: Y screen position for the window

defaultParameters.name: width
defaultParameters.description: Width of the window (in pixels)

defaultParameters.name: height
defaultParameters.description: Height of the window (in pixels)

defaultParameters.name: text
defaultParameters.description: Text to be displayed. Supports the same modifiers as Show Text command

commands.name: Update window
commands.description: Update contents of window of given ID (variable values for example)

defaultParameters.name: id
defaultParameters.description: ID of the window

commands.name: Edit content
commands.description: Edit the text content of an existing window

defaultParameters.name: id
defaultParameters.description: ID of the window to edit

defaultParameters.name: text
defaultParameters.description: New text to be displayed

commands.name: Mark selected
commands.description: Mark a certain window as selected. Useful for making custom choices

defaultParameters.name: id
defaultParameters.description: ID of the window

defaultParameters.name: select
defaultParameters.description: Whether to select or dismiss that window

commands.name: Get window under cursor
commands.description: Store the ID of the window under the cursor in the variable of given ID

defaultParameters.name: variable
defaultParameters.description: ID of the variable to store the result (null if not found)

defaultParameters.name: choices
defaultParameters.description: List of choices

defaultParameters.name: x
defaultParameters.description: The leftmost coordinate of the choice list

defaultParameters.name: y
defaultParameters.description: The topmost coordinate of the choice list

defaultParameters.name: width
defaultParameters.description: Width of the individual choice window

defaultParameters.name: height
defaultParameters.description: Height of the individual choice window

defaultParameters.name: spacing
defaultParameters.description: Space between each choice window

defaultParameters.name: selected
defaultParameters.description: ID of the default choice

defaultParameters.name: cancel
defaultParameters.description: ID of the choice treated as "cancel"

defaultParameters.name: result
defaultParameters.description: ID of the variable where to store the result

defaultParameters.name: disableCancel
defaultParameters.description: Whether to disable the cancel option

commands.name: Pause
commands.description: Pauses the game, similar to when you open the default menu. Doesn't do anything if the game is already paused.

commands.name: Unpause
commands.description: Unpauses the game if it is paused.

commands.name: Wait
commands.description: Waits a set time. Stops counting when the game is paused.

defaultParameters.name: time
defaultParameters.description: Time to wait in seconds.
